title: An evaluation of aging measures: from biomarkers to clocks.
authors: Wang, Qingyi; Hou, Tongyao; Wang, Qiwen; He, Jiamin; Wang, Lan; Si, Jianmin; Chen, Shujie
one_liner_zh: 该文综述衰老生物标志物与衰老时钟，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作、转录因子结合或相关AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: With the increasing number of aged population and growing burden of healthy aging demands, a rational standard for evaluation aging is in urgent need. The advancement of medical testing technology and the prospering of artificial intelligence make it possible to evaluate the biological status of aging from a more comprehensive view. In this review, we introduced common aging biomarkers and concluded several famous aging clocks. Aging biomarkers reflect changes in the organism at a molecular or cellular level over time while aging clocks tend to be more of a generalization of the overall state of the organism. We expect to construct a framework for aging evaluation measurement from both micro and macro perspectives. Especially, population-specific aging clocks and multi-omics aging clocks may better fit the demands to evaluate aging in a comprehensive and multidimensional manner and make a detailed classification to represent different aging rates at tissue/organ levels. This framework will promisingly provide a crucial basis for disease diagnosis and intervention assessment in geroscience.
abstract_zh: 随着老年人口数量的不断增加及健康老龄化需求的日益增长，亟需建立一套合理的衰老评估标准。医学检测技术的进步与人工智能的蓬勃发展，使得从更全面的视角评估衰老的生物学状态成为可能。本综述中，我们介绍了常见的衰老生物标志物，并总结了若干著名的衰老时钟。衰老生物标志物反映生物体在分子或细胞水平上随时间发生的变化，而衰老时钟则更倾向于对生物体整体状态的概括。我们期望从微观与宏观两个层面构建一个衰老评估测量框架。特别是，针对特定人群的衰老时钟及多组学衰老时钟可能更符合全面、多维评估衰老的需求，并能进行详细分类，以代表组织/器官水平上的不同衰老速率。该框架有望为老年科学中的疾病诊断和干预评估提供重要基础。
